payload.title: Protected rubric index

sections.heading: Analytic scoring
sections.text: The summative and transfer ProtectedScoringSpec records contain the exact decimal-reasoning rubric version and descriptors. Learners receive criteria only. An authorized human scores constructed reasoning; an AI recommendation cannot supply an official score.
